headline: Pace Digitek completes acquisition via newly incorporated wholly owned subsidiary
sum: Pace Digitek Limited has incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary and completed an acquisition through the vehicle, as intimated to NSE on 21 August 2026.
implication: The use of a special-purpose wholly owned subsidiary as an acquisition vehicle is a standard Indian M&A structure for ring-fencing liabilities and maintaining regulatory clarity; the completion intimation triggers post-deal disclosure obligations under Listing Rules.
detail: Pace Digitek Limited, a listed entity on NSE, has informed the stock exchange of two concurrent corporate events: (1) incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary (WOS), and (2) completion of an acquisition effected through that subsidiary. The intimation was filed on 21 August 2026. No acquisition consideration, target entity name, or operational details were disclosed in the NSE filing extract. The structure-using a special-purpose wholly owned subsidiary as the acquisition vehicle-is routine for Indian M&A but requires post-completion disclosure, NCLT approval (if applicable), and updating of shareholding patterns.

framework.note: Definition and incorporation procedure for wholly owned subsidiary; mandatory MCA registration within 30 days of issue of certificate.
Central - material events requiring immediate disclosure to stock exchange; acquisition completion is a Schedule III event.
Updating shareholding pattern and related-party transaction (RPT) disclosures post-acquisition.
Potential inter-corporate loss carry-forward rules and section 79 restrictions on change of ownership impacting tax position of acquisition target.
CCI approval required if acquisition value or combined turnover triggers thresholds (≥₹2,000 cr combined); exemption for wholly owned subsidiaries may apply.
If acquisition involves foreign investment or outbound acquisition, RBI approval under LRS/ECB rules may apply.
Stock exchange disclosure and corporate action settlement obligations for listed acquirer.

conditions: Regulatory filing with stock exchange (completed 21 Aug 2026)
approvals: Board approval for WOS incorporation and acquisition (assumed; not stated)

structure.novel: Use of wholly owned subsidiary as acquisition vehicle is standard M&A practice in India; no novel structural feature evident from filing.

triggers.note: Acquisition completion is a Schedule III material event triggering mandatory disclosure within 24 hours of consummation.
Wholly owned subsidiary incorporation and shareholding documentation must comply with MCA filing requirements.
Acquisition may require CCI approval depending on combined turnover/asset thresholds; subsidiary exemption may apply.
